summary: 4 blocking spec review findings triaged as apply; each requires a concrete spec repair before gate.

items.title: Gate recovery scope conflicts with tracked gate phases
items.rationale: The spec must distinguish recoverable gate task-impl/integration phases from tracked but unsupported draft/spec gate phases.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[0] notes run-gate tracks draft, spec, task-impl, and integration while set-retry only accepts gate task-impl and integration.

items.title: Review recovery has no persisted failure baseline
items.rationale: Review recovery cannot compare changed evidence unless review FAIL/stop handling persists a baseline fingerprint.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[1] states reviewRetry metrics alone do not store the prior failure fingerprint.

items.title: Evidence source mapping is undefined
items.rationale: Eligibility and display must use the same bounded source mapping so tests and implementation agree on changed evidence.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[2] lists multiple possible phase-specific sources and requires a minimal mapping.

items.title: Recovery artifact target is unspecified
items.rationale: The audit requirement needs a named spec-local file and entry schema for implementation and tests.
items.evidence: spec-review.json blockingFindings[3] says no artifact path or container shape is specified.
